Our Awesome Advantages

Aim High

We fund your education, provide pensions, and offer many opportunities for job growth.

Join the Fun

With cool Dudes & Dudettes, you’ll enjoy your time at the office and at off-hours hangouts.

Live it Up

We’re a family-friendly company that respects your time–both on and off the job.

Play Hard

Work with cutting-edge technologies including React, Spring Boot, Node.js and Java in a serverless architecture.

Love Your Location

Work next to Sarona market, with breathtaking sea views and delicious restaurants that will accept your 10bis.

Make an Impact

Your ideas and initiatives can impact our product and every other aspect of Duda.

Work Perks & Benefits

Cha-ching

We offer competitive compensation, 401k, stock options and tuition reimbursement.

Check-ups

We’ve got you covered with comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance.

TGIF

home. Pajama dress code encouraged.

Good Times

Duda’s Commitment to Diversity

In order for a company to be at its very best, we believe it must incorporate people from various backgrounds, whether they be ethnic, religious, or connected to gender, sexual orientation and more. Every day, we seek to make Duda a more diverse company –– and we promise to keep doing better.
